component.name: Malama
component.summary: Native Linux chat client for local Ollama LLMs

description.p:
Malama is a lightweight, native Linux desktop chat client built with C++23 and wxWidgets.
It connects directly to a local Ollama instance over TCP and provides a complete LLM chat workspace without Electron, an embedded browser engine, or a required external cloud service

ul.li: Native desktop UI, no browser runtime required
Session tweaking and token budget tracking
Works entirely offline with local Ollama models
